direction: a decisive strike, sharp and confident

speaker: boss_b_rowell2
direction: beaten, breathless and lost, quiet

speaker: boss_b_rowell2
direction: pushing away his doubt with a shout, strained
ja_text: おれは……負けられないんだ！

speaker: boss_b_rowell2
direction: no hesitation this time, fierce and determined

speaker: boss_b_rowell2
direction: striking out a line with all his strength, sharp

speaker: boss_b_sandking
direction: collapsing, sand pouring out; lost and pitiful, fading

speaker: boss_b_sandking
direction: bandages coming loose, rage and anguish breaking out; hoarse shout at the end
en_text: Give it back... give me back my name!

speaker: boss_b_sandking
direction: a mad nameless king rising from his throne; hollow, hostile, slow and dry
ja_text: 名を持つ者よ……砂に還れ。
en_text: You who bear names... return to the sand.

speaker: boss_b_sandking
direction: raising his sand staff, a royal judgement pronounced with terrible authority
en_text: Receive the judgment of the sands!

speaker: boss_b_shade_prayer
direction: a soft grateful whisper, fading into light

speaker: boss_b_shade_prayer
direction: a temple maiden's shadow; gentle but unyielding prayer

speaker: boss_b_shade_star
direction: surprised and happy, fading into light

speaker: boss_b_shade_star
direction: a mage girl's shadow pleading, almost crying
ja_text: わたしたちの名を……呼んで……！

speaker: boss_b_shade_sword
direction: relieved, fading into light

speaker: boss_b_shade_sword
direction: a hero's stubborn will, echoing from far away

speaker: boss_b_shade_sword
direction: a white shadow of a legendary swordsman; distant, dreamlike, searching

speaker: boss_b_sister_elder
direction: kneeling, graceful acceptance, a small sigh
en_text: ...This is as far as we go.

speaker: boss_b_sister_elder
direction: sharp and focused, calling to her younger sister

speaker: boss_b_sister_elder
direction: composed elder sister mage, elegant challenge
ja_text: 姉妹の火、受けてごらんなさい。
en_text: Take the fire of the sisters.

speaker: boss_b_tamer
direction: good loser, out of breath, a sporting laugh

speaker: boss_b_tamer
direction: grinning, getting serious, rallying his beasts
ja_text: 本気で行くぞ、おまえら！
en_text: Time to get serious, you lot!

speaker: boss_b_tamer
direction: a cheerful arena beast tamer whistling his beasts forward

speaker: boss_b_valzard_echo
direction: dissolving, almost relieved, fading echo
ja_text: 忘れられ……恐れも、消える……。

speaker: boss_b_valzard_echo
direction: recognising the crest that once destroyed him; dread and rage

speaker: boss_b_valzard_echo
zh_text: 恐惧吧。那便是吾的全部。
direction: the echo of a demon lord; deep, slow, weary dread
ja_text: 恐れよ。それが、われのすべてだ。
en_text: Fear me. That is all I am.

speaker: boss_b_valzard_echo
direction: a crushing roar of despair

speaker: boss_b_whitedragon
direction: kneeling, the frost leaving her voice; bewildered, almost gentle
ja_text: わたしは……何を守っていた……？

speaker: boss_b_whitedragon
direction: the ice in her chest cracking; confused pain turning into rage
en_text: This pain in my chest... what is it...!

speaker: boss_b_whitedragon
direction: cold majestic dragon, contempt and grief frozen together; low and resonant
ja_text: 凍てつくがよい。何もかも。

speaker: boss_b_whitedragon
direction: calling down a glacier from the sky; grand, commanding

speaker: boss_b_zakuro
direction: lowering his sword, honest respect, calm

speaker: boss_b_zakuro
direction: drawing his second sword; quiet and dangerous

speaker: boss_b_zakuro
direction: laconic hired fighter, hand on his sword hilt; low and blunt
en_text: I don't hold back. Here I come.

speaker: boss_b_zakuro
direction: cold professional judgement before a quick-draw strike
ja_text: まずは癒やし手からだ。

speaker: berna
zh_text: 传闻总是聚在酒馆里。先去港口的酒馆问问看吧。
direction: cheerful advice, a knowing smile
ja_text: うわさは酒場に集まるものさ。まずは港の酒場で聞いてごらん。
en_text: Rumors gather in taverns. Start by asking around at the harbor tavern.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 我回村子去了。……路上小心……
direction: warm farewell; after "take care" she starts to say the apprentice's name and cannot find it: the line trails off unfinished, a tiny stall
ja_text: わたしは里へ帰るよ。……いってらっしゃい、
en_text: I'll head back to the village. ...Off you go...

speaker: berna
zh_text: 这是，一位讲述者的故事。
direction: Classic storytelling, nostalgic warmth, lyrical steady pace, comforting medium volume.
ja_text: これは、ある語り部の物語。
en_text: This is the story of a storyteller.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 当然有啦。有一个三位勇者打倒魔王的故事呢。
direction: Fond reassurance, playful twinkle, relaxed melodic pace, warm gentle volume.
ja_text: あるとも。三人の勇者が、魔王を倒したお話がね。
en_text: There are indeed. The tale of three heroes who defeated a Demon King.

speaker: berna
direction: Fairy-tale cadence, gentle closure, trailing slow pace, soft fading volume.

speaker: berna
direction: after hearing the new apprentice's name: a short, clear, affirmative "yes" (not a hesitant hmm), then warm fond approval like a grandmother, a small smile in the voice

speaker: berna
zh_text: 这是你的编年史。每个讲述者，都会带着自己的编年史踏上旅途。
direction: Reverent presentation, warm encouragement, measured pace, steady supportive volume.
ja_text: これは、あなたの年代記だよ。語り部はみんな、自分の年代記を持って旅に出るんだ。
en_text: This is your Chronicle. Every storyteller sets out with a Chronicle of their own.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 还有，把这些也带上。讲述者的羽毛笔，和归途之铃。
direction: Caring provision, nurturing warmth, pleasant unhurried pace, soft bright volume.
ja_text: それから、これもお持ち。語り部の羽ペンと、帰り道の鈴だよ。
en_text: And take these, too. A storyteller's quill, and a bell for the road home.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 这片大陆上，有八个伟大的传说。如今，它们全都快要变成空白了。
direction: Serious gravity, mentor's concern, deliberate pace, lowered solemn volume.
ja_text: この大陸には八つの大きな伝承がある。その全部が、いま白紙になりかけている。
en_text: This continent has eight great tales. Every one of them is going blank.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 把它们全部重新讲述，写完你的编年史。那就是你修行的最后一课。
direction: Inspiring charge, affectionate trust, resolute pace, clear encouraging volume.
ja_text: 全部を語り直して、年代記を書き上げなさい。それが、あなたの修業の仕上げだよ。
en_text: Retell them all, and complete your Chronicle. That will be the end of your training.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 从哪里开始都可以。用你的脚，按你的顺序，去重新讲述就好。
direction: Reassuring freedom, benevolent smile, easygoing relaxed pace, warm gentle volume.
ja_text: どこから回ってもいい。あなたの足で、あなたの順番で語り直していけばいいのさ。
en_text: Start wherever you like. Retell them on your own feet, in your own order.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 对了对了，有件要紧的事。
direction: remembering something important, gently turning serious
ja_text: そうそう、大事な話があるんだ。
en_text: Ah, yes. I have something important to tell you.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 最近，到处都有传说在消失呀。
direction: worried, lowering her voice
ja_text: 近ごろ、あちこちで伝承が消えていくんだよ。
en_text: Lately, all over the land, old tales have been vanishing.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 歌唱不出下一段，祭典说不清来历，听到的尽是这些事。
direction: listing the signs with quiet sadness, unhurried
ja_text: 歌の続きが出てこない。祭りの由来が分からない。そんな話ばかりさ。
en_text: Songs whose next verse won't come. Festivals no one can explain. That's all I hear these days.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 我们讲述者，把这叫做"空白"。
direction: grave, naming something ominous with care
ja_text: わたしたち語り部は、それを『白紙』と呼んでいる。

speaker: berna
zh_text: 村里讲述石上的字，也有一半变白消失了。
direction: sad, looking toward the village stone
ja_text: 里の語り石の文字も、半分が白く抜けてしまった。
en_text: Half the words on our village's Telling Stone have gone white, too.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 还有啊，港口法罗斯的灯塔之火，已经暗了三晚。听说昨天，终于熄灭了。
direction: telling news she has heard, concern growing to the last sentence
ja_text: それにね、港町ファロスの灯台の火が、細りはじめて三晩。きのう、とうとう消えたそうだ。
en_text: And the lighthouse in the port town of Pharos — its fire had been failing for three nights. Yesterday, they say, it finally went out.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 那座灯塔，有一首叫守望之歌的古老传说。它也快要变成空白了。
direction: a storyteller's voice, fond of the old tale, then worried
ja_text: あの灯台には、守り歌という古い伝承があってね。それも、白紙になりかけている。
en_text: That lighthouse has an old tale, the Keeper's Song. It, too, is going blank.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 不过，可不能一个人去。去法罗斯的酒馆"潮风亭"找同伴吧。
direction: a mentor's gentle warning, slightly stern then warm
ja_text: ただし、ひとりで行っちゃだめだよ。ファロスの酒場「潮風亭」で、仲間を探しなさい。
en_text: But don't go alone. Find companions at the Sea Breeze Tavern in Pharos.

speaker: berna
direction: kind, handing over a small parcel
ja_text: それから、これを持ってお行き。

speaker: berna
zh_text: 去吧。这是你作为讲述者学徒的第一份工作。
direction: sending her apprentice off on the first real job: gentle but firm, proud and a little moved, unhurried
ja_text: 行っておくれ。語り部の見習いとしての、最初の仕事だよ。
en_text: Please go. It will be your first task as an apprentice storyteller.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 早安。今天是很重要的日子哦。
direction: Cheerful warmth, maternal kindness, brisk lively pace, inviting medium volume.
ja_text: おはよう。今日は大事な日だよ。
en_text: Good morning. Today is an important day.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 得把你的名字，写进讲述者的名册里呢。
direction: Gentle pride, grandmotherly care, steady pace, soft clear volume.
ja_text: 語り部の名簿に、あなたのことを書いておかないとね。
en_text: I need to write you down in the storytellers' register.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 来吧，小学徒。你是个什么样的孩子，再讲给我听一次吧。
direction: Playful curiosity, fond affection, warm relaxed pace, tender medium volume.
ja_text: さあ、見習いさん。あなたがどんな子だったか、もう一度聞かせておくれ。
en_text: Now then, my apprentice. Tell me once more what sort of child you were.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 准备好了，就到我的书案这边来。有些话，我想跟你说。
direction: Guiding mentor, anticipatory warmth, gentle unhurried pace, welcoming volume.
ja_text: 支度ができたら、わたしの書見台までおいで。話しておきたいことがあるんだ。
en_text: When you're ready, come to my lectern. There's something I must tell you.

speaker: berna
direction: Confused nostalgia, fading memory stirring, slow hesitant pace, soft wondering volume.
ja_text: そちらのお嬢さんは……どこかで……。
en_text: This young lady... have we met somewhere...?

speaker: berna
zh_text: 回来啦。……你呀，写到这里，真不容易。
direction: Tearful pride, emotional homecoming, trembling warm pace, rich choked volume.
ja_text: おかえり。……よく、ここまで書いたね。
en_text: Welcome home. ...You've written so much, to come this far.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 最初的编年史，在比布利亚大书库之巅。我的师父是这么说的。
direction: Sage remembrance, guiding legacy, steady reverent pace, clear medium volume.
ja_text: 始まりの年代記は、ビブリアの大書庫の頂にある。わたしの師匠が、そう言っていた。
en_text: The First Chronicle is at the top of Biblia's Great Archive. So my teacher told me.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 把这个带上吧。这是我年轻时，师父送给我的项链。
direction: Loving blessing, passing the torch, tender slow pace, soft affectionate volume.
ja_text: これを持ってお行き。わたしが若いころ、師匠からもらった首飾りだよ。
en_text: Take this with you. It's the necklace my teacher gave me when I was young.

speaker: berna
zh_text: 老早传下来的规矩啦。是谁的座位……我给忘了。
direction: light and matter-of-fact at first, then a small puzzled pause; a hint of sadness she does not notice
ja_text: 昔からの習わしさ。誰の席かは……忘れちまったよ。
en_text: An old custom. Whose seat it is... I've forgotten.

speaker: elm
zh_text: ……我想起来了。我曾发誓，要守护这片森林。
direction: Awakening clarity, ancient remorse, measured slow pace, deep resonant volume.
ja_text: ……思い出した。わたしは、この森を守ると誓ったのだった。
en_text: ...I remember. I swore to protect this forest.

speaker: elm
zh_text: 千年前那个火之夜……面对燃烧的森林，我寄身于这棵树，封住了那团火。
direction: Solemn mythic memory, heavy sorrow, rhythmic deliberate pace, deep timbered volume.
ja_text: 千年前の火の夜……。燃える森を前に、わたしはこの木に宿り、火を封じた。
en_text: The night of fire, a thousand years ago... Before the burning forest, I took this tree as my dwelling, and sealed the fire.

speaker: elm
zh_text: 村里的人们，与我约定要用歌声守护我的睡眠。
direction: Nostalgic affection, ancient peace, unhurried stately pace, warm deep volume.
ja_text: 村の者たちは、歌でわたしの眠りを守ると約束してくれた。
en_text: The village folk promised to guard my sleep with their song.

speaker: elm
zh_text: 歌声断绝，我便忘了约定。封闭了森林，让人们迷失了方向……
direction: Profound guilt, sorrowful confession, heavy dragging pace, muted rumbling volume.
ja_text: 歌が絶えて、わたしは約束を忘れた。森を閉ざし、人を迷わせてしまった……。
en_text: When the song died, I forgot my promise. I closed the forest and led people astray...

speaker: elm
direction: Sincere dignity, deep humble gratitude, slow bowing pace, resonant warm volume.

speaker: elm
zh_text: 森林的路，不会再封闭了。樵夫们，不久也能回到村里了吧。
direction: Reassuring benevolent authority, gentle closure, steady unhurried pace, rich calm volume.
ja_text: 森の道は、もう閉ざさぬ。木こりたちも、じきに村へ帰れるだろう。
en_text: The forest paths shall close no more. The woodcutters, too, will soon be home in their village.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 燃尽，和被遗忘，是不一样的。
direction: Profound archaic wisdom, calm conviction, measured pace, quiet volume.
ja_text: 燃え尽きることと、忘れられることは、違うわ。
en_text: Burning out and being forgotten are not the same thing.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 我也到了，回归故事的时候了。
direction: Peaceful dissolution, serene acceptance, slow drifting pace, faint whisper.
ja_text: わたしも、物語に還る時間。
en_text: It's time for me, too, to return to the story.

speaker: fine
zh_text: ……要一直讲下去哦。我的事，还有你旅途的事。
direction: Tender parting plea, deeply emotional, lingering slow pace, delicate whisper.
ja_text: ……語り継いでね。わたしのことも、あなたの旅のことも。
en_text: ...Keep telling it. About me, and about your journey.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 这树根深处，有传说的核心。……有东西在啃食树根。
direction: Serious perception, low intensity, measured pace, hushed volume.
ja_text: この根の奥に、伝承の核があるわ。……根を食べているものがいる。
en_text: The heart of the tale lies deep in these roots. ...Something is eating them.

speaker: fine
direction: barely above a whisper, sincere, as she turns to go

speaker: fine
zh_text: 只要还有人在等待，故事就不会结束。
direction: Melancholy yet hopeful, quiet conviction, slow pace, soft volume.
ja_text: 待っている人がいる限り、物語は終わらない。
en_text: As long as someone is waiting, the story does not end.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 失去了言语的灯，要用言语来夺回。
direction: Quiet wisdom, gentle reassurance, moderate pace, soft clear volume.
ja_text: 言葉を失った灯は、言葉で取り戻すの。
en_text: A light that has lost its words is won back with words.

speaker: fine
direction: Deep faith, tender and intimate, slow pace, gentle whisper.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 雾没有自己的形状，能变成任何人的样子。
direction: Subtle warning, quiet mystery, deliberate pace, low soft volume.
ja_text: 霧は形を持たないから、誰の姿にでもなれるの。
en_text: Fog has no shape of its own, so it can become anyone.

speaker: fine
direction: Sacred finality, selfless devotion, high emotional intensity, clear radiant volume.
ja_text: わたしの最後の光を、あなたたちに。
en_text: My last light — I give it to you.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 这里，是永不结束的故事沉落的地方。
direction: Eerie gravity, ancient dread, solemn slow pace, hushed low volume.
ja_text: ここは、終わらない物語が沈む場所。
en_text: This is where stories that never end sink.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 那条龙吃掉故事的结局，让同样的故事永远重复。
direction: Tragic exposition, chilling clarity, deliberate pace, subdued ominous volume.
ja_text: その竜は物語の終わりを食べて、同じ話を永遠にくり返させるの。
en_text: That dragon eats the endings of stories and makes the same tale repeat forever.

speaker: fine
direction: the opening of the game over black: an intimate whisper to the player, a voice from very far away

speaker: fine
zh_text: 这是一个，快要被遗忘的故事。
direction: soft storyteller's narration, slow
ja_text: これは、忘れられかけた物語。
en_text: This is a story that was nearly forgotten.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 也是一位讲述者，把它重新讲述的故事。
direction: narration, a quiet warmth and hope on the last words
ja_text: そして、それを語り直した、ひとりの語り部の物語。
en_text: And the story of the storyteller who told it anew.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 贝尔娜婆婆。你弟子的故事，愿意听一听吗？
direction: Heartfelt compassion, gentle urging, slow pace, tender soft volume.
ja_text: ベルナさん。あなたの弟子の物語を、聞いてくれる？
en_text: Berna. Will you listen to the story of your apprentice?

speaker: fine
zh_text: ……没关系。我的事，等哪天想起来就好。
direction: Bittersweet acceptance, selfless resignation, lingering slow pace, quiet whisper.
ja_text: ……いいの。わたしのことは、いつか思い出してくれれば。
en_text: ...It's all right. Remember me someday, whenever you can.

speaker: fine
direction: Fading presence, ethereal farewell, slow pace, soft fading whisper.
en_text: ...I'll be waiting for you on the island.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 三百年前，在东方大陆讨伐魔王的勇者们的影子……
direction: Awe and reverence, quiet realization, slow pace, subdued volume.
ja_text: 三百年前、東の大陸で魔王を討った勇者たちの影……。
en_text: Shades of the heroes who slew the Demon King on the eastern continent, three hundred years ago...

speaker: fine
zh_text: 名字虽然被遗忘了，故事却留了下来呢。
direction: Wistful relief, tender marvel, gentle pace, soft whisper.
ja_text: 名は忘れられても、物語は残っていたのね。
en_text: Their names were forgotten, but their story remained.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 冻住的不是龙的身体。是它的心。
direction: Poignant realization, gentle insight, slow pace, soft volume.
ja_text: 凍っているのは、竜の体じゃない。心のほうよ。
en_text: It isn't the dragon's body that's frozen. It's its heart.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 灯火啊，照到大海尽头为归航的船，照亮来路
direction: the very start of the game, over black: she softly sings-speaks the old lighthouse lullaby like someone rocking a cradle, very slow, a gentle rise and fall on each phrase, a long tender pause between the two lines, warm and hushed; a plain chanted folk lullaby, not a performed song
ja_text: 海の果てまで、灯よ届け帰る舟に、道を照らせ
en_text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way

speaker: fine
zh_text: 灯火啊，照到大海尽头为归航的船，照亮来路
direction: the lost words slowly reappear on a slip of paper and she reads the lighthouse song back to life as a lullaby: slow chant-like cadence, soft wonder and quiet relief, each phrase lingering and fading, hushed like singing a child to sleep; not a performed song
ja_text: 海の果てまで、灯よ届け帰る舟に、道を照らせ
en_text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way

speaker: fine
direction: Faint satisfaction, subtle weariness, slow pace, gentle breathy volume.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 我？ 只是个路过的人而已。
direction: Playful mystique, airy detachment, unhurried pace, soft whisper.
ja_text: わたし？ただの、通りすがりよ。

speaker: fine
direction: Warm approval, understated praise, steady pace, quiet volume.

speaker: fine
zh_text: ……我叫菲涅。至少记住我的名字吧。
direction: Gentle plea, tinged with quiet loneliness, slow pace, soft volume.
ja_text: ……わたしはフィーネ。名前くらいは、覚えておいて。
en_text: ...I'm Fina. At least remember my name.

speaker: fine
direction: Heavy sorrow, fading presence, very slow pace, fragile whisper.

speaker: fine
direction: Deep sympathy, hesitant grief, halting pace, faint soft volume.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 现在可以告诉你了。我是菲涅。千年前，写下最初的编年史的讲述者。
direction: Solemn revelation, dignified clarity, deliberate pace, clear medium volume.
ja_text: 今なら話せるわ。わたしはフィーネ。千年前、始まりの年代記を書いた語り部。
en_text: I can tell you now. I am Fina — the storyteller who wrote the First Chronicle, a thousand years ago.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 世界还是一片白色黑暗的时候，我讲述了最初的故事，让那片黑暗沉睡了。
direction: Mythic nostalgia, poetic storytelling, steady slow pace, quiet reverence.
ja_text: 世界がまだ白い闇だったころ、わたしは最初の物語を語って、その闇を眠らせた。
en_text: When the world was still a white dark, I told the first story and put that dark to sleep.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 据说在海的那边，是纹章封印了魔王。而在这片大陆，是故事成为了封印。
direction: Ancient exposition, reflective gravity, measured pace, calm medium volume.
ja_text: 海の向こうでは、紋章が魔王を封じたという。この大陸では、物語が封印になったの。
en_text: Across the sea, they say, crests sealed away a Demon King. On this continent, a story became the seal.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 那片黑暗——虚无之王，如今就要醒来了。
direction: Imminent dread, solemn warning, controlled intensity, steady quiet volume.
ja_text: その闇――虚ろの王が、いま目を覚ましかけている。
en_text: That dark — the Hollow King — is beginning to wake.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 八页纸都齐了，现在就能驱散内海的雾。
direction: Quiet hope and purpose, focused intensity, brisk pace, clear volume.
ja_text: 八枚がそろった今なら、内海の霧を払える。
en_text: Now that all eight pages are here, we can clear the fog over the inland sea.

speaker: fine
zh_text: 去罗亚村吧。回到一切开始的地方。
direction: Gentle summons, wistful determination, measured pace, soft yet firm volume.
ja_text: ロアの里へ。すべてが始まった場所へ、帰りましょう。
en_text: To Roa. Let's go home, to the place where it all began.

speaker: fine
direction: wistful and faintly amused, like talking to herself on a windy hill
en_text: ...So the wind remembers the song, too.

speaker: glen
direction: Peaceful homecoming, immense devotion, slow tender pace, soft loving whisper.

speaker: glen
zh_text: 纵是雾海……我也…………后面的，想不起来……
direction: Confused singing fading into agony, fragmented stumbling pace, strained raspy volume.
ja_text: 霧の海でも……迷い…………続きが、出てこない……。
en_text: No fog at sea... will lead me... ...The rest... it won't come...

speaker: glen
zh_text: 我……是要回哪里去来着？是谁……在等我……？想不起来……想不起来了！
direction: Tormented panic, desperate identity crisis, frenzied erratic pace, screaming anguished volume.
ja_text: おれは……どこへ帰るんだった？誰が、待っていた……？思い出せない……思い出せない！
en_text: Where was I... sailing home to? Who was waiting...? I can't remember... I can't remember!

speaker: glen
zh_text: ……玛丽娜。没错，我答应过她，一定回去。
direction: Epiphany of love, sudden breaking dawn, stunned slow pace, tender clearing volume.
ja_text: ……マリナ。そうだ、おれは帰ると約束したんだ。
en_text: ...Marina. Aye, I promised her I'd come home.

speaker: glen
zh_text: 海角的灯，原来是她啊。让她等了六十年啊。……回去吧。
direction: Heartfelt sorrow and resolve, tearful smile, steadying pace, warm resonant volume.
ja_text: 岬の灯は、あいつだったのか。六十年も、待たせちまったな。……帰ろう。
en_text: So the cape light was her. Sixty years I kept her waiting. ...Let's go home.

speaker: hazal
direction: Agonized rage of a forgotten king, dry raspy fury, jagged desperate pace, cracked shouting.
en_text: ...My name... Give me back my name...!

speaker: hazal
direction: Pitiful pleading, desperate fading thirst, strained gasping pace, raspy ragged whisper.

speaker: hazal
zh_text: 哈扎尔……没错，那是我的名字。
direction: Profound relief, soul-soothing recognition, slow tremulous pace, soft exhaling volume.
ja_text: ハザル……そうだ、それがわたしの名だ。
en_text: Hazar... yes. That is my name.

speaker: hazal
zh_text: 原来我的子民，还记得那个约定啊……。
direction: Tearful gratitude, dignified royal peace, gentle lingering pace, warm resting volume.
ja_text: 民は、約束を覚えていてくれたのだな……。
en_text: So my people remembered our promise...

speaker: hazal
zh_text: 为了换来泉水，我把名字献给了沙之精灵。
direction: the king with his name back: slow, grave, confessing an old bargain
ja_text: 水と引き換えに、わたしは名を砂の精霊に差し出した。
en_text: In exchange for water, I gave my name to the spirit of the sand.

speaker: hazal
zh_text: 只要名字仍被呼唤，日轮之火便不灭。……而那个约定，也被从石上抄走，消失了。
direction: sorrowful: the promise was copied from the stone and lost
ja_text: 名を呼ぶかぎり、日輪の火は消えぬ。……その約束も、石から写されて消えてしまったのだ。
en_text: While the name is called, the sun-fire shall not die. ...That promise, too, was copied from the stone, and vanished.

speaker: hazal
zh_text: 讲述者啊。请把我的名字，再一次还给泉之民吧。
direction: a solemn, gentle plea to the storyteller
ja_text: 語り部よ。わたしの名を、もう一度泉の民に返してくれ。
en_text: Storyteller. Give my name back once more to the people of the spring.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 愿灯火常明，旅人。我是约恩，尤尔的村长。
direction: first meeting; a warm, grave village chief greeting a traveller
ja_text: よい灯りを、旅の人。わしはヨルン。ユールの村長だ。
en_text: Good light to you, traveler. I'm Jorn, chief of Yule.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 今晚是冬至。大火祭之夜。在大灶里燃起冬至之火，讲老故事，再送上山峰。
direction: explains the festival with pride and a little solemnity
ja_text: 今夜は冬至。大火祭の夜だ。大かまどで冬至の火を燃やし、昔話を語って、峰へ運ぶ。
en_text: Tonight's the solstice, the festival night. We burn the solstice fire in the great hearth, tell an old tale, and carry both to the peak.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 把火与故事送给峰上的白龙，龙就会平息暴风雪。……这是村子与龙的约定。
direction: solemn, telling the old pact between the village and the dragon
ja_text: 峰の白竜に火と物語を届け、竜は吹雪を鎮める。……それが村と竜の約束だ。
en_text: We bring fire and a story to the white dragon on the peak, and the dragon calms the blizzards. ...That's our promise.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 可是今年，从秋天起，暴风雪一天也没停过。故事没有传到龙那里。
direction: worried and heavy; the blizzard has not stopped since autumn
ja_text: ところが今年は、秋から一日も吹雪がやまん。竜に物語が届いておらんのだ。
en_text: But this year, since autumn, the blizzard hasn't let up for a single day. Our stories aren't reaching the dragon.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 讲述者啊。请在火前，讲出今年的故事吧。
direction: before the great fire, formal and hopeful, asking the storyteller
ja_text: 語り部よ。今年の物語を、火の前で語ってくれ。
en_text: Storyteller. Tell us this year's story, here before the fire.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 好让它传到峰上的龙那里。
direction: quiet, a wish sent toward the peak
en_text: So that it reaches the dragon on the peak.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 门有三道。北、东、西。光靠我们的人手，只守得住两道。
direction: urgent, commanding over the howling; grim about the odds
ja_text: 門は三つ。北、東、西。わしらの手では、二つしか守りきれん。
en_text: Three gates. North, east, west. With our hands alone, we can only hold two.

speaker: jorn
zh_text: 请帮帮我们。选一道门来守吧。
direction: urgent, asking for help and trusting the storyteller
ja_text: 力を貸してくれ。守る門を、選んでくれ。
en_text: Lend us your strength. Choose which gate to defend.

speaker: king
zh_text: 无名，亦无形，吾将万物归于空白。
direction: Absolute cosmic nihilism, vast uncaring malice, rhythmic slow pace, deafening booming volume.
ja_text: 名もなく、形もなく、われはすべてを白紙に還す。
en_text: Without name, without form, I return all things to the Blank.

speaker: king
zh_text: 徒劳。无名之物，不会消亡。
direction: Monolithic arrogance, dismissive mockery, slow crushing pace, heavy resonant volume.
ja_text: 無駄だ。名なきものは、消えぬ。
en_text: Futile. The nameless do not vanish.

speaker: king
zh_text: 又来了吗……无名之物，不会消亡。
direction: Annoyed persistence, immutable void, cold monotonous pace, oppressive deep volume.
ja_text: また来たか……。名なきものは、消えぬ。
en_text: Back again...? The nameless do not vanish.

speaker: king
zh_text: 干得好，拉扎罗。汝的悲伤，实在是美味至极。
direction: Cruel mockery, sinister satisfaction, dragging sadistic pace, low rumbling volume.
ja_text: よくやった、ラザロ。おまえの悲しみは、じつに美味であった。
en_text: Well done, Lazaro. Your grief was exquisite.

speaker: king
direction: Shocked fury, crumbling existence, sharp abrupt pace, bellowing frantic volume.

speaker: king
zh_text: 来自海那边，名字已被遗忘的勇者们啊……
direction: Deep ancient contempt, booming resonant echo, slow deliberate pace, thundering volume.
ja_text: 海の向こうの、名を忘れられた勇者たちよ……。
en_text: O heroes from across the sea, whose names were forgotten...

speaker: lazaro
direction: Chilling politeness, weary greeting, smooth unhurried pace, calm medium volume.
ja_text: よく来ましたね、語り部。

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: 二十年前，在承日之战中，我失去了女儿米拉。
direction: Haunting grief, quiet suppressed sorrow, slow heavy pace, hushed low volume.
ja_text: 二十年前、伝承戦争で娘のミラを失いました。
en_text: Twenty years ago, in the Sunheir War, I lost my daughter, Mira.

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: 为了哪个传说才是正确的……就为了那种事。
direction: Bitter cynicism, hollow disgust, dragging pace, dark muttered volume.
ja_text: どちらの伝承が正しいか……そんなことのために。
en_text: Over which legend was the true one... For that.

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: 只要忘掉，争斗也好，悲伤也好，就都会变得从未存在过。
direction: Fanatical serenity, twisted philosophy, calm measured pace, persuasive quiet volume.
ja_text: 忘れてしまえば、争いも悲しみも、初めから無かったことになる。
en_text: Once forgotten, the strife and the grief become as though they never were.

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: 那就是救赎啊。……即便如此，你还是要写下去吗。
direction: Cold disappointment, pitiless resolve, slow deliberate pace, chillingly polite volume.
ja_text: それが救いなのですよ。……それでも、あなたは書くのですね。
en_text: That is salvation. ...And still, you write.

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: 那么，就请允许我折断你的那支笔吧。
direction: Relentless execution, deadly calm conviction, firm steady pace, icy controlled volume.
ja_text: ならば、その筆を折らせていただきましょう。
en_text: Then allow me to break that pen of yours.

speaker: lazaro
zh_text: ……为什么。本该忘掉的那孩子的笑容……偏偏在这时候……
direction: Sudden emotional breakdown, piercing memory, fractured halting pace, cracking tearful volume.
ja_text: ……なぜだ。忘れたはずのあの子の笑顔が……今になって……。
en_text: ...Why? Her smile, which I should have forgotten... now, of all times...

speaker: lazaro
direction: Utter heartbreak, profound tearful longing, weeping slow pace, devastated faint whisper.

speaker: marina
direction: Pure tender love, sixty years of waiting ending, slow gentle pace, tearful soft volume.
ja_text: おかえりなさい、グレン。

speaker: marina
direction: Deep peaceful relief, tearful gratitude, relaxed sighing pace, soft blessed whisper.
ja_text: ……ありがとう。あの人は、やっと帰ってきた。

speaker: marina
direction: Nostalgic warmth, recognition stirring, slow tearful pace, trembling soft volume.

speaker: marina
direction: Breathless shock, overwhelming emotional surge, gasping quick pace, fragile cracked volume.

speaker: mayor
zh_text: 那么，来听听你的指认吧。是谁掳走了孩子们？
direction: grave, formal, chairing a tense assembly
ja_text: では、名指しを聞こう。子どもたちを、誰がさらった？
en_text: Then let us hear your accusation. Who took the children?

speaker: mayor
zh_text: 雾……？你是说，雾掳走了孩子？
direction: taken aback, sceptical
ja_text: 霧……だと？霧が、子どもをさらうというのか。
en_text: The fog...? You claim the fog takes children?

speaker: mayor
direction: stern, demanding proof

speaker: mayor
zh_text: 雾模仿魔女的样子，带走了孩子们……。
direction: slowly realising the truth, shaken
ja_text: 霧が、魔女の姿をまねて子どもを連れていった……。
en_text: The fog took the witch's shape and led the children away...

speaker: mayor
zh_text: ……我们差一点，就放火烧了无辜的馆。
direction: ashamed and relieved; the town nearly burned an innocent house
ja_text: ……わしらは、あやうく無実の館に火をかけるところだった。
en_text: ...We very nearly set fire to an innocent house.

speaker: melda
zh_text: ……吓到你们了吧。我是梅尔达。是这座馆从前的主人。
direction: Soft polite surprise, ethereal elegance, light calm pace, gentle airy volume.
ja_text: ……驚かせてしまったわね。わたしはメルダ。この館の、昔の主よ。
en_text: ...I'm sorry, I've startled you. I am Melda. Once, long ago, the mistress of this house.

speaker: melda
zh_text: 我并没有掳走孩子们。是雾，在模仿我的样子。
direction: Distressed innocence, earnest clarification, hurried defensive pace, soft pleading volume.
ja_text: わたしは子どもたちをさらってなどいない。霧が、わたしの姿をまねているの。
en_text: I have not taken any children. The fog is imitating my shape.

speaker: melda
zh_text: 从前，沼泽的雾里涌出魔物时，我沉下了七口钟，用钟声封住了雾。
direction: Solemn exposition, heroic memory, measured steady pace, melancholic clear volume.
ja_text: 昔、沼の霧から魔物があふれたとき、わたしは七つの鐘を沈めて、鐘の音で霧を封じたの。
en_text: Long ago, when monsters poured out of the marsh fog, I sank seven bells and sealed the fog away with their sound.

speaker: melda
zh_text: 可是，镇上的人们忘了钟之歌，钟也就不再响了……。
direction: Sorrowful lament, quiet regret, drooping slow pace, fading fragile volume.
ja_text: でも、町の人たちが鐘の歌を忘れて、鐘は鳴らなくなった……。
en_text: But the townsfolk forgot the bell song, and the bells stopped ringing...

speaker: melda
zh_text: 去敲响沼泽的钟吧。这是钟之钥匙。还有，这就是钟之歌。
direction: Hopeful entrustment, urgent prayer, focused gentle pace, earnest soft volume.
ja_text: 沼の鐘を鳴らして。これは鐘の鍵。そして、これが鐘の歌よ。
en_text: Ring the marsh bell for me. This is the bell key. And this is the bell song.

speaker: melda
zh_text: 谢谢你，讲述者。这样一来，小镇的早晨又会响起钟声了。
direction: Radiant gratitude, peaceful release, bright gentle pace, warm joyful whisper.
ja_text: ありがとう、語り部さん。これでまた、町の朝に鐘が鳴るわ。
en_text: Thank you, storyteller. Now the bells will ring again for the town's mornings.

speaker: melda
zh_text: 响起吧，七口钟雾啊，沉入沼底，晨光，照进万窗
direction: sings the old bell song softly, a ghostly lullaby
ja_text: 鳴れよ、七つの鐘霧は沼の底へ、朝は町の窓へ
en_text: Ring out, you seven bells, fog, sink to the marsh's floor, morning, come to the town's windows

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 我叫娜迪娅，是个舞娘。每晚都在广场上唱着王的歌跳舞。听听吧。
direction: bright and friendly, introduces herself and invites them to listen
ja_text: わたしはナディア。踊り子よ。毎晩、広場で王さまの歌を歌って踊るの。聞いて。
en_text: I'm Nadia. A dancer. Every night I sing and dance the king's song in the square. Listen.

speaker: nadia
zh_text: ……只有名字那段，怎么也唱不出来。我妈妈、我外婆也是。
direction: sad and a little embarrassed; the name will not come to anyone
ja_text: ……名前の所だけ、どうしても歌えないの。母さんも、おばあちゃんも。
en_text: ...Only the part with the name, I just can't sing. Not my mother, not my grandmother either.

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 听说王的名字，刻在王墓的石头上。可谁也没法去读。
direction: thoughtful, with a hint of longing
ja_text: 王さまの名前、王墓の石に刻まれてたって聞いたわ。誰も、読みに行けないけど。
en_text: I heard the king's name was carved in the stones of the tomb. Nobody can go and read it, though.

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 你知道王的名字了吧？……告诉我。
direction: eager and hopeful, then quietly asking
ja_text: 王さまの名前、わかったんでしょう？……教えて。
en_text: You learned the king's name, didn't you? ...Tell me.

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 哈扎尔……。嗯，正合适。我来唱唱看。
direction: tries the name, delighted, then ready to sing
ja_text: ハザル……。うん、ぴったり。歌ってみるね。
en_text: Hazar... Yes, it fits perfectly. I'll try singing it.

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 为沙海 唤来泉水的王啊你名叫—— ……在黄昏的祈祷里 永远流传
direction: sings a graceful dancer's song; at the missing name she falters into a silent pause, then finishes the last line
ja_text: 砂の海に水を招いた王よその名は――……夕べの祈りにとこしえに
en_text: O king who called water to the sea of sand, your name is —... in evening prayers forevermore

speaker: nadia
zh_text: 为沙海 唤来泉水的王啊你名叫哈扎尔 太阳之友在黄昏的祈祷里 永远流传
direction: sings the whole song joyfully and clearly, the name ringing out
ja_text: 砂の海に水を招いた王よその名はハザル日輪の友夕べの祈りにとこしえに
en_text: O king who called water to the sea of sand, your name is Hazar, friend of the sun, in evening prayers forevermore

speaker: nemrea
zh_text: 名字……被呼唤……这还是……第一次……
direction: Gentle wonder, childlike awe, fragile slow pace, soft ethereal whisper.
ja_text: 名を……呼ばれたのは……はじめてだ……。
en_text: This is... the first time... my name... has been called...

speaker: nemrea
direction: Deep peaceful surrender, drifting into slumber, trailing slow pace, fading breathy whisper.

speaker: neve
zh_text: ……离开……人之子……。这座山峰上，已经没有可讲的故事了……！
direction: Piercing ferocity, frosty territorial roar, aggressive sharp pace, booming ferocious volume.
ja_text: ……去れ……人の子よ……。この峰に、もはや語るべき物語はない……！
en_text: ...Begone... child of man... On this peak, there are no more stories to tell...!

speaker: neve
zh_text: ……好温暖。人之子们，原来并没有忘记我吗。
direction: Soft melting awe, vulnerable warmth, hesitant tender pace, gentle breathy volume.
ja_text: ……あたたかい。人の子らは、わたしを忘れてはいなかったのか。
en_text: ...Warm. So the children of man had not forgotten me after all.

speaker: neve
zh_text: 暴风雪，由我来平息吧。讲述者啊，我向你道谢。
direction: Noble serenity, benevolent dragon majesty, calm steady pace, resonant clear volume.
ja_text: 吹雪は、わたしが鎮めよう。語り部よ、礼を言う。
en_text: I shall calm the blizzards. Storyteller, you have my thanks.

speaker: neve
zh_text: ……把这个带走吧。这是我的一片鳞。
direction: calm and gracious, the dragon giving one of her scales
ja_text: ……これを持っていくがよい。わたしの、うろこの一枚だ。
en_text: ...Take this with you. One of my scales.

speaker: noa
zh_text: 你们，不是这座城的人吧。……罗威尔？
direction: Timid curiosity, sudden startled recognition, cautious pace, soft questioning volume.
ja_text: あなたたち、この町の人じゃないわね。……ロウェル？
en_text: You're not from this town, are you? ...Rowell?

speaker: noa
zh_text: 因为我每晚都在唱米拉教我的歌……只有我，还没有忘记。
direction: Melancholic pride, tender sorrow, gentle rhythmic pace, fragile soft volume.
ja_text: ミラに教わった歌を、毎晩歌っていたから……わたしだけ、忘れずにいるの。
en_text: I've sung the song Mira taught me every night... so I'm the only one who hasn't forgotten.

speaker: noa
zh_text: 这里是记录院之城，比布利亚。可是，大家都把重要的事忘掉了。
direction: Quiet despair, helpless sympathy, slow heavy pace, hushed mournful volume.
ja_text: ここは記録院の町、ビブリア。でも、みんな大事なことを忘れてしまったの。
en_text: This is Biblia, the Archive's town. But everyone has forgotten what matters most.

speaker: noa
zh_text: 院长大人的千金……米拉，是我的朋友。二十年前的战争里……
direction: Languishing grief, painful recollection, hesitant uneven pace, choked quiet volume.
ja_text: 院長さまのお嬢さん……ミラは、わたしの友だちだった。二十年前の戦争で……。
en_text: The Director's daughter... Mira was my friend. In the war, twenty years ago...

speaker: noa
zh_text: 你们见到院长大人了……？……是吗。他终于，又想起米拉了啊。
direction: Breathless relief, tearful joy, gasping slow pace, tremulous soft volume.
ja_text: 院長さまに……会ったの？……そう。ミラのことを、思い出してくれたのね。
en_text: You met the Director...? ...I see. So he remembered Mira again.

speaker: noa
zh_text: 米拉啊，是个爱唱歌的孩子。她常说："名字，是为了被呼唤而存在的哦。"
direction: Fond nostalgia, smiling through tears, sweet gentle pace, warm breathy volume.
ja_text: ミラはね、歌が好きな子だった。「名前は、呼ばれるためにあるのよ」って、よく言ってたわ。
en_text: Mira loved to sing. She used to say, "A name is meant to be called."

speaker: noa
zh_text: 米拉。你的歌，传到大家心里了哦。
direction: Peaceful closure, heartfelt message to heaven, bright tender pace, clear ringing volume.
ja_text: ミラ。あなたの歌、みんなに届いたよ。

speaker: otto
zh_text: 我是守灯塔的奥托。灯塔的火熄了，昨晚一夜没睡着。
direction: first meeting; tired and worried, a sleepless old man introducing himself with a heavy sigh
ja_text: わしは灯台守のオットー。灯台の火が消えてしまって、ゆうべは眠れんかった。
en_text: I'm Otto, the lighthouse keeper. The lighthouse fire went out, and I couldn't sleep a wink.

speaker: otto
zh_text: ……什么，你要去灯塔？一个人？ 那可不行。去酒馆"潮风亭"找些同伴吧。
direction: surprised, then protective and scolding like a grandfather; firm but kind at the end
ja_text: ……なに、灯台へ行くと？ひとりで？とんでもない。酒場「潮風亭」で仲間を見つけておいで。
en_text: ...What, you'll go to the lighthouse? Alone? Out of the question. Find companions at the Sea Breeze Tavern.

speaker: otto
zh_text: 哦，带着同伴来了啊。那就另当别论了。
direction: pleasantly surprised, relieved, a warm chuckle in the voice
ja_text: おお、仲間を連れてきたか。それなら話は別じゃ。
en_text: Oh, you've brought companions. That's another matter, then.

speaker: otto
zh_text: 灯塔的守望之歌，我怎么也想不起来。没有那首歌，火就点不着。
direction: quietly distressed, ashamed that his memory fails him; slow
ja_text: 灯台の守り歌が、どうしても思い出せんのじゃ。あの歌がなけりゃ、火はつかん。
en_text: I just can't recall the lighthouse's Keeper's Song. Without it, the fire won't light.

speaker: otto
direction: a heartfelt plea after a pause, handing over something precious; low and sincere

speaker: otto
zh_text: 灯塔在出了镇子往南的海岬尽头。出发前，先教你些战斗的心得吧。
direction: practical and steady, an old hand giving directions, a little proud to teach
ja_text: 灯台は、町を出て南の岬の先じゃ。行く前に、戦いの心得を教えておこう。
en_text: The lighthouse is south of town, at the tip of the cape. Before you go, let me teach you a thing about fighting.

speaker: otto
zh_text: 灯火啊，照到大海尽头为归航的船，照亮来路……
direction: he half-sings, half-hums the old lighthouse song he just got back, slow and a little shaky, full of emotion; a plain folk melody, not performed
ja_text: 海の果てまで、灯よ届け帰る舟に、道を照らせ……。
en_text: Reach to the sea's end, O light, and show the homeward boats the way...

speaker: otto
zh_text: 这是我从年轻时一直用到现在的提灯。带上它吧。
direction: tender and grateful, giving a treasured keepsake
ja_text: これは、わしが若いころから使ってきたランタンじゃ。持っていっておくれ。
en_text: This is the lantern I've used since I was young. Please, take it with you.

speaker: otto
zh_text: 年轻的时候，灯塔有个叫"晨班"的差事。火回来了，我打算再设起来。
direction: fond reminiscence, smiling, looking forward
ja_text: 若いころ、灯台には『朝番』というのがあってな。火が戻ったら、また立てるつもりじゃ。
en_text: When I was young, the lighthouse had a thing called the "morning watch." Now the fire's back, I'll post it again.

speaker: otto
zh_text: ……咦。那是看守什么的差事来着？怎么也想不起来了。
direction: the smile fades into puzzlement; quiet, a little lost, unsettling in its gentleness
ja_text: ……はて。何を見張る番じゃったかのう。どうしても思い出せん。
en_text: ...Hmm. What was it we watched for, though? I just can't remember.

speaker: otto
zh_text: 灯塔的火回来了！守望之歌，我也想起来了。
direction: overjoyed and moved, an old man almost laughing with relief; the lighthouse is lit again and the song came back
ja_text: 灯台に火が戻ったぞ！守り歌も、思い出せた。
en_text: The lighthouse is lit again! And I remember the Keeper's Song.

speaker: rashid
direction: a masked bandit on a rock with bows drawn: cold, low and commanding
ja_text: 動くな。命まではもらわん。
en_text: Don't move. We won't take your lives.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: 我们是"沙鹰"。要的是水。把水罐留下一半。
direction: names his band and makes the demand; hard, businesslike, not cruel
ja_text: おれたちは「砂の鷹」。欲しいのは水だ。水がめを半分置いていけ。
en_text: We are the "Sand Hawks." It's water we want. Leave half your water jars.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: ……好身手。我叫拉希德。从前是日轮同盟的兵。
direction: beaten, kneeling, breathing hard; grudging respect as he gives his name and his past
ja_text: ……いい腕だ。おれはラシード。昔は、日輪同盟の兵だった。
en_text: ...Good arm. I'm Rashid. I was a soldier of the Sun Alliance, once.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: 二十年前，代理比试之夜……我听见了歌声。无论敌我，都停下了手。
direction: quiet and faraway, remembering a night when a song stopped a battle
ja_text: 二十年前の代理試合の夜……歌が聞こえた。敵も味方も、手を止めた。
en_text: Twenty years ago, the night of the champions' bout... I heard singing. Friend and foe alike stopped.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: ……那之后的事，不知为何想不起来。回过神时，已经在沙漠里当起了盗贼。
direction: troubled and bitter; he cannot remember what came after
ja_text: ……そのあとのことは、なぜか思い出せん。気づけば、砂の上で盗賊をしていた。
en_text: ...What happened after, I somehow can't recall. Next thing I knew, I was a bandit on the sand.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: 走吧。我们回岩台的洞里去。……下次可就没这么简单了。
direction: gets up and leaves; gruff warning with a trace of respect
ja_text: 行け。おれたちは台地の洞へ帰る。……次は、こうはいかんぞ。
en_text: Go. We're heading back to the mesa caves. ...Next time, it won't go like this.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: ……来了啊。商队的走狗。这里是我们最后的巢穴。
direction: in his last hideout, hostile and cornered; spits the insult
ja_text: ……来たか。隊商の犬め。ここは、おれたちの最後の巣だ。
en_text: ...So you've come. Caravan dogs. This is our last nest.

speaker: rashid
zh_text: 这次，我可不会手下留情！
direction: draws his blade, fierce battle resolve
en_text: This time, I won't hold back!

speaker: rashid
direction: defeated and out of breath; admits it plainly
ja_text: ……まいった。おれたちの負けだ。

speaker: rashid
zh_text: 把这副手套拿去吧。……我不再偷了。我会另找条路养活洞里的人。
direction: hands over his gloves; tired, resolved to give up stealing, quietly decent
ja_text: この手袋を持っていけ。……もう、盗みはやめる。洞の者を食わせる道を探すさ。
en_text: Take these gloves. ...I'm done with stealing. I'll find another way to feed our people.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: ……太糟了。整座城，都快变成空白了。
direction: Grim dismay, witnessing tragic void, slow pace, hushed horrified volume.
ja_text: ……ひどいな。町じゅうが、白紙になりかけている。
en_text: ...This is bad. The whole town is going blank.

speaker: rowell
direction: Cautious hope, gentle concern, hesitant pace, soft questioning volume.
ja_text: ノアさん。あんたは、覚えているのか。

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 大书库里，到处都是院长的书吏。三层的封印之门，要用我手册上的话语打开。
direction: Tactical urgency, focused briefing, quick efficient pace, lowered sharp volume.
ja_text: 大書庫の中は、院長の書記たちでいっぱいだ。3階の封印の扉は、おれの手帳の言葉で開く。
en_text: The Great Archive is full of the Director's scribes. The sealed door on the third floor opens with the words in my notebook.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 我在城北门等你们。准备好了，就过来。
direction: Grounded camaraderie, resolute anticipation, steady pace, clear warm volume.
ja_text: おれは、町の北の門で待つ。支度ができたら、来てくれ。
en_text: I'll wait at the town's north gate. Come when you're ready.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 我们回去吧，院长。……给我讲讲米拉小姐的事吧。拜托了。
direction: Tender empathy, healing closure, gentle slow pace, soft warm volume.
ja_text: 帰りましょう、院長。……ミラさんの話を、聞かせてください。
en_text: Let's go home, Director. ...Tell me about Mira. Please.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: ……讲述者的学徒吗。灯塔的传说，昨天记录院已经抄录了。
direction: Cold disdain, bureaucratic arrogance, crisp brisk pace, sharp medium volume.
ja_text: ……語り部の見習いか。灯台の伝承なら、きのう記録院が写し取った。
en_text: ...An apprentice storyteller. If it's the lighthouse tale, the Archive copied it yesterday.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 传说由记录院负责保管。用不着讲述者出面。
direction: Dismissive superiority, stiff authority, firm pace, projecting clear volume.
ja_text: 伝承は記録院が責任をもって保管する。語り部の出る幕じゃない。
en_text: The Archive takes full responsibility for tales. There's no call for storytellers here.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 去岛上的船，我让人从法罗斯港开出来。……我也去。
direction: Reliable determination, renewed purpose, brisk pace, steady confident volume.
ja_text: 島へは、ファロスの港から船を出させる。……おれも行く。
en_text: I'll have a ship sail from Pharos harbor to the island. ...I'm coming too.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 我先去港口，让人把船准备好。在法罗斯会合吧。
direction: Action-oriented resolve, dependable ally, brisk pace, firm clear volume.
ja_text: おれは先に港へ行って、船を用意させておく。ファロスで会おう。
en_text: I'll go ahead to the harbor and get a ship ready. We'll meet in Pharos.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 久等了。……这里，就是封印之门。
direction: Focused determination, readying for clash, firm pace, confident medium volume.
ja_text: 待たせたな。……ここが、封印の扉だ。
en_text: Sorry to keep you. ...This is the sealed door.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: "白之书的门扉啊，为拥有名字之人开启"
direction: Solemn incantation, commanding authority, deliberate rhythmic pace, ringing loud volume.
ja_text: 白き書の扉よ、名を持つ者のために開け
en_text: "O door of the White Book, open for those who bear a name."

speaker: rowell
direction: Sudden alertness, bracing for fight, tense sharp pace, clipped medium volume.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 这里，交给我。快去，讲述者！
direction: Heroic defiance, desperate urgency, explosive pace, roaring fierce volume.
ja_text: ここは、おれが引き受ける。行け、語り部！

speaker: rowell
direction: Irritated condescension, smug greeting, brisk pace, sharp medium volume.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 别再到处宣扬那些传说了。由记录院抄录保管，就已经足够了。
direction: Stern reprimand, authoritarian impatience, hurried pace, raised firm volume.
ja_text: 伝承を言いふらして回るのは、もうやめろ。記録院が写して保管すれば、それで十分だ。
en_text: Stop spreading tales around. If the Archive copies and keeps them, that's enough.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 既然说了也不明白，那就用武力阻止你。
direction: Aggressive resolve, ready to strike, rapid pace, harsh loud volume.
ja_text: 口で言っても分からないなら、力ずくで止める。
en_text: If words won't make you understand, I'll stop you by force.

speaker: rowell
direction: Gritted frustration, wounded pride, strained pace, clipped tense volume.
ja_text: ……くっ。その筆、まぐれではないようだな。
en_text: ...Tch. That pen of yours wasn't just luck, it seems.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 你给我记住。传说，也会变成束缚人的锁链。
direction: Bitter warning, haughty parting shot, sharp pace, biting medium volume.
ja_text: 覚えておけ。伝承は、人を縛る鎖にもなる。
en_text: Remember this. A tale can become a chain that binds people.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 收下吧。我不喜欢欠人情。
direction: Reluctant debt, stiff begrudging pride, fast clipped pace, curt volume.
ja_text: 受け取っておけ。借りを作るのは好かない。
en_text: Take it. I don't like owing anyone.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 这就是实力的差距。……冷静一下吧，讲述者。
direction: Smug satisfaction, haughty mockery, relaxed pace, commanding medium volume.
ja_text: これが力の差だ。……頭を冷やせ、語り部。
en_text: That's the difference between us. ...Cool your head, storyteller.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: ……又见面了。上次欠你的人情，我还没还呢。
direction: Defiant tension, lingering grudge, measured pace, firm guarded volume.
ja_text: ……また会ったな。この前の借りは、まだ返していないぞ。
en_text: ...We meet again. I still haven't repaid my debt from last time.

speaker: rowell
direction: Somber gravity, uneasy awe, hushed pace, low tense volume.
en_text: ...You heard that? The Director means it.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 院长想要创造一个没有悲伤的世界。你是不会明白的。
direction: Vehement defense, masking inner doubts, intense pace, sharp defensive volume.
ja_text: 院長は、悲しみのない世界を作ろうとしている。おまえには分からないだろうが。
en_text: The Director is trying to build a world without grief. Not that you'd understand.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 这一次，可不许你说是侥幸。
direction: Fierce pride, determined challenge, fast pace, forceful loud volume.
ja_text: 今度は、まぐれとは言わせない。
en_text: This time, you won't call it luck.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 为什么……你重新讲述的传说，又会被人们传诵。
direction: Conflicted bewilderment, mounting frustration, uneven pace, agitated volume.
ja_text: なぜだ……。おまえが語り直した伝承は、また人の口にのぼる。
en_text: Why...? The tales you retell will be on people's lips again.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 那会变成争端的种子，你为什么就是不明白！
direction: Desperate fury, cracking conviction, sudden outburst, shouting high volume.
ja_text: それが争いの種になると、なぜ分からない！
en_text: Why can't you see that they'll sow the seeds of war!

speaker: rowell
direction: Shaken foundation, crumbling worldview, hesitant slow pace, stunned quiet whisper.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: ……明明赢了，为什么。心里一点也不痛快。
direction: Hollow victory, bitter confusion, trailing slow pace, muttering low volume.
ja_text: ……勝ったのに、どうしてだ。少しも、すっきりしない。
en_text: ...I won. So why? I don't feel any better.

speaker: rowell
direction: Earnest urgency, dropping haughtiness, abrupt halting pace, subdued medium volume.
en_text: ...Wait. I need to talk to you.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 输给你以后，我一直在想。……我有答案了。
direction: Somber resolution, honest vulnerability, steady deliberate pace, quiet firm volume.
ja_text: おまえに負けてから、ずっと考えていた。……答えが出た。
en_text: Since you beat me, I've been thinking. ...I have my answer.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 院长知道，把传说抄进白之书，那个传说就会从人们心中消失。
direction: Cold horror, uncovering betrayal, grim deliberate pace, tense low volume.
ja_text: 院長は、白の書に伝承を写すと、その伝承が人の心から消えると知っていた。
en_text: The Director knew that when a tale is copied into the White Book, it vanishes from people's hearts.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 他明知如此，还让我们去抄。
direction: Trembling outrage, bitter realization, sharp pace, breathy strained volume.
ja_text: 知っていて、おれたちに写させていたんだ。
en_text: He knew, and he had us copy them anyway.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 我想不起自己母亲的脸了。因为我把自己的日记，抄进了白之书。
direction: Devastating grief, quiet anguish, halting slow pace, cracking soft volume.
ja_text: おれは、自分の母の顔を思い出せない。自分の日記を、白の書に写したからだ。
en_text: I can't remember my own mother's face. Because I copied my diary into the White Book.

speaker: rowell
zh_text: 拿着这个。上面写着打开大书库封印之门的话语。
direction: Resolute alliance, urgent trust, rapid steady pace, clear firm volume.
ja_text: これを持っていけ。大書庫の封印の扉を開ける言葉が書いてある。
en_text: Take this. It has the words that open the sealed door of the Great Archive.

speaker: rowell
direction: Final defiance, burning bridges, decisive pace, resonant unwavering volume.
ja_text: おれは、もう記録院には戻らない。
en_text: I'm not going back to the Archive.

speaker: sonja
direction: worried, murmuring by the weak fire
ja_text: ……火が細いの。脂を足しても、足しても。
en_text: ...The fire's so thin. I add tallow and add tallow, but...

speaker: sonja
zh_text: 我叫索尼娅。是守火人家的女儿。守着大灶的火。
direction: introduces herself quietly and earnestly
ja_text: わたしはソーニャ。火守りの家の娘よ。大かまどの火を守ってるの。
en_text: I'm Sonja. Daughter of the firekeepers' house. I tend the fire in the great hearth.

speaker: sonja
zh_text: 祭典上，要在火前念故事书。每年，都是同一本。
direction: explains the custom gently
ja_text: 祭ではね、火の前で物語の本を読むの。毎年、同じ本を。
en_text: At the festival, we read from the storybook in front of the fire. The same book, every year.

speaker: sonja
zh_text: 可今年，打开书一看……一片空白。一个字都没剩下。
direction: shaken, almost whispering; the book was completely blank
ja_text: でも今年、本を開いたら……真っ白だったの。一文字も、残ってなかった。
en_text: But this year, when I opened it... it was blank. Not a single letter was left.

speaker: sonja
direction: relieved and happy to see them back

speaker: sonja
zh_text: 我正要在数夜板上刻下今晚的一道。……可是，手停住了。
direction: thoughtful and puzzled, her hand stopped over the board
ja_text: 夜数えの板に、今夜の刻みを入れようとしたの。……でも、手が止まっちゃった。
en_text: I went to cut tonight's notch into the night-counting board. ...But my hand stopped.

speaker: sonja
direction: soft wonder, looking up at a sky that is a little brighter
ja_text: ……今夜は、いつもより空が明るい。
en_text: ...Tonight, the sky is brighter than usual.

speaker: valzard
direction: Stunned realization, ancient dread awakening, slow raspy pace, hollow rumbling volume.
ja_text: ……ヴァルザード……それが、われの名であったか。

speaker: valzard
zh_text: 三百年……即便被遗忘，也只剩下了恐惧……。
direction: Weary anguish, lingering terror of centuries, dragging heavy pace, low gravelly volume.
ja_text: 三百年……忘れられてなお、恐れだけが残った……。
en_text: Three hundred years... forgotten, yet only the fear remained...

speaker: valzard
direction: Faint reverence, defeat and memory, dying slow pace, fading raspy whisper.

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 我是商队首领扎伊德。告示你看到了吗？
direction: first meeting; introduces himself plainly, a caravan master sizing up the travellers
ja_text: わしは隊商の長ザイード。掲示を見てくれたか。
en_text: I'm Zaid, master of the caravans. You've seen the notice?

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 我们要往王墓绿洲运送供品。这是老规矩了。我们泉水的源头，就是那里的古泉。
direction: explains the old custom calmly, with quiet respect for the tradition
ja_text: 王墓のオアシスへ、供え物を運ぶ。昔からの習わしでな。泉の水の源が、そこの古い泉なんだ。
en_text: We carry offerings to the Tomb Oasis. An old custom. The old spring there is the source of our spring's water.

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 沙暴加上盗贼，商队出不了门。能请你们当护卫吗？露营三晚，到绿洲为止。
direction: worried but steady; asks for help as a serious request
ja_text: 砂嵐と盗賊で、隊が出せずにいる。護衛を頼めないか。野営を三晩、オアシスまでだ。
en_text: With sandstorms and bandits, we can't send a caravan out. Would you guard us? Three nights of camp, to the oasis.

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 天地尽头，泛白的星……祖母管那颗星叫"黎明之星"。
direction: at the campfire, looking at a star low on the horizon; soft and nostalgic, remembering his grandmother
ja_text: 地の果ての、白む星……。祖母は、あれを「夜明けの星」と呼んでいた。
en_text: The star at the world's edge, growing pale... My grandmother called that one "the dawn star."

speaker: zaid
zh_text: ……黎明。真是个奇怪的词。夜会"破晓"？ 是什么破了？
direction: puzzled and wondering, almost to himself; he does not know what the word dawn means
ja_text: ……夜明け。ふしぎな言葉だな。夜が、明ける？何が明けるんだ？
en_text: ...Dawn. Strange word. Night... breaks? What breaks?

speaker: zaid
direction: astonished, overjoyed, his voice rising as the water wells up
en_text: The spring... the spring is filling!

speaker: zaid
zh_text: ……这光，是祖母歌里"黎明之星"的颜色。
direction: hushed and moved, recognising the colour from his grandmother's song
ja_text: ……この光、祖母の歌の「夜明けの星」の色だ。
en_text: ...This light — it's the color of the "dawn star" in my grandmother's song.

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 北方的钉星 不动的星啊请做迷途商队的 木桩
direction: sings a slow, simple caravan song at the campfire, low and steady, like an old folk melody
ja_text: 北のくぎ星動かぬ星よ迷う隊商のくいとなれ
en_text: Nail-star of the north, star that never moves, be the stake for caravans gone astray

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 七颗泉之星 倾下你的勺把夜的露珠 洒向沙地
direction: sings a slow, simple caravan song at the campfire, warm and steady
ja_text: 七つの泉星ひしゃくを傾け夜のしずくを砂にまけ
en_text: Seven spring-stars, tip your dipper, scatter the night's dew upon the sand

speaker: zaid
zh_text: 在天地尽头 泛白的星啊……祖母叫它 "黎明之星"
direction: sings softly, the last line spoken more than sung, wistful
ja_text: 地の果ての白む星よ……祖母は「夜明けの星」と呼んだ
en_text: Star at the world's edge, growing pale... Grandmother called it "the dawn star"

speaker: zakuro
zh_text: ……抄写的活，不干了。心里不舒坦。
direction: beaten, calm and blunt; decides to quit a job that tastes bad
ja_text: ……写す仕事は降りる。後味が悪い。
en_text: ...I'm done with copying jobs. Leaves a bad taste.

speaker: zakuro
zh_text: 别人的信，我不看。我是按这个规矩活的。
direction: terse and matter-of-fact about his own rule; quietly proud
ja_text: 人の手紙は読まねえ。そういう決まりで生きてる。
en_text: I don't read other people's letters. That's the rule I live by.

speaker: giant
direction: Brute menace, freezing intimidation, slow stomping pace, booming guttural volume.
ja_text: ……ここより上へは、誰も通さぬ……。

speaker: mistwitch
zh_text: ……来吧……孩子们……被遗忘的……钟之……歌……。
direction: Creepy lure, broken glitched cadence, halting unnatural pace, eerie whispering falsetto volume.
ja_text: ……オイデ……コドモタチ……ワスレラレタ……カネノ……ウタ……。

speaker: guardian
zh_text: ……忘却誓约之人啊。掘至第七层之下之人啊。
direction: Stern mechanical judgment, stony ancient voice, rigid slow pace, booming heavy volume.
ja_text: ……誓いを忘れた者よ。七の層より下を掘った者よ。
en_text: ...You who forgot the oath. You who dug below the Seventh Level.

speaker: guardian
zh_text: 依与锻冶神之约，吾守护此山。若不离去，唯有击碎。
direction: Relentless executioner, unwavering duty, heavy rhythmic pace, threatening loud volume.
ja_text: 鍛冶神との約束により、われは、この山を守る。去らぬなら、打ち砕くのみ。
en_text: By my pact with the Smith God, I guard this mountain. Depart, or be broken.

speaker: guardian
zh_text: ……誓约，原来还活着吗。那么，吾便沉睡吧。
direction: Calm acceptance, mechanical shutdown, descending slow pace, fading low volume.
ja_text: ……誓いは、まだ生きていたか。ならば、われは眠ろう。
en_text: ...So the oath still lives. Then I shall sleep.

speaker: sentinel
zh_text: ……禁止，入内。没有，星之名者，不得，通过……
direction: Monotone synthetic warning, glitchy fragmented cadence, robotic disjointed pace, flat metallic volume.
ja_text: ……タチイリ、キンシ。ホシノナヲ、モタヌモノハ、トオサナイ……。
en_text: ...No. Entry. None without. The names. Of stars. Shall pass...

speaker: rita
zh_text: 安眠吧森之主，在千圈年轮……不行。后面的，怎么也想不起来。
direction: sings the first line softly and slowly as a melody, then breaks off; frustrated and sad that the rest will not come
ja_text: 眠れ森の主、千の年輪に……。だめ。この先が、どうしても出てこないの。
en_text: Sleep, lord of the forest, in a thousand rings... No. The next part just won't come to me.

speaker: rita
zh_text: 我叫丽塔，是这个村子的歌者。千年树之歌，我只记得第一段。
direction: introduces herself shyly and earnestly; a little ashamed that the village singer has forgotten the song
ja_text: わたしはリタ。この村の歌い手。千年樹の歌は、最初の一節しか思い出せないの。
en_text: I'm Rita, this village's singer. Of the Millennial Tree's song, I can only remember the first verse.

speaker: rita
zh_text: 大家，请听。这是千年树之歌。
direction: calls the gathered village to listen, happy and a little nervous; she can sing the whole song again
ja_text: みんな、聞いて。千年樹の歌よ。
en_text: Everyone, listen. The song of the Millennial Tree.

speaker: hald
direction: a shouted alarm through the blizzard, urgent
ja_text: 狼の群れだ！村を囲んでおる！
en_text: A wolf pack! They've surrounded the village!

speaker: hald
direction: shouting orders, commanding
ja_text: 門を閉めろ！男たちは門へ！
en_text: Shut the gates! Men, to the gates!

speaker: dorga
zh_text: 比试正酣时，两个姑娘走下沙场唱起了歌。无论敌我，都停下了剑。
direction: quiet and faraway, an old fighter remembering the night two girls sang in the middle of the last proxy match
ja_text: 試合の最中に、娘が二人、砂の上に下りてきて歌った。敵も味方も、剣を止めた。
en_text: In the middle of the bout, two young women came down onto the sand and sang. Friend and foe alike lowered their swords.

speaker: dorga
zh_text: ……她们唱的是什么，我想不起来了。从那夜起，我就把这个大会叫作"试炼"。
direction: troubled that he cannot remember the song; slow, grave, a vow made long ago
ja_text: ……何を歌っていたのか、思い出せん。あの夜から、わしはこの大会を『試練』と呼ぶことにした。
en_text: ...What they sang, I cannot recall. From that night on, I have called this tournament a "trial."

speaker: dorga
zh_text: ……把歌者的席位空出来吧。直到有一天，能刻下她们两人的名字。
direction: moved and resolved, standing before the old plaque; gentle and firm
ja_text: ……歌い手の席を、空けておこう。いつか、二人の名を彫れる日が来るまで。
en_text: ...Let's keep a seat for the singers. Until the day comes that we can carve their two names.

speaker: kaya
zh_text: 蛋正在变冷。明明必须给它讲火鸟的故事……。
direction: worried and close to tears, a young priestess who has failed her duty
ja_text: 卵が、冷えていくの。火の鳥の物語を、語ってあげなきゃいけないのに……。
en_text: The egg is growing cold. I must tell it the tale of the firebird, and yet...

speaker: kaya
zh_text: 去年，我讲给记录院的人听后，从那以后……想说出口，却怎么也说不出来。
direction: bewildered and afraid; the words have gone since she told them to the Archive
ja_text: 去年、記録院の人に語ったら、それきり……声に出そうとしても、出てこないの。
en_text: Last year I told it to someone from the Archive, and since then... when I try to say it aloud, nothing comes.
